game_name: Super Sidekicks 3 - The Next Glory / Tokuten Ou 3 - Eikou e no Chousen
general_issues: Select ssideki3.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
